PLAN "12-Week Upper-Body Focused Programme for Subacromial Impingement (Pain-Free, No Overhead Loading)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build shoulder stability and upper-body strength within pain-free range; avoid overhead loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Pain-Free Mobility" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation Push/Pull"
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Goblet squat 3x12
          Bent_over_row 3x12
          Floor_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Assisted_pull_apart 3x15
        cooldown:
          banded_external_rotations 2x12
    WEEK 1: Tuesday rest
    WEEK 1: Wednesday training 40m "Stability & Mobility"
      warmup:
        mobility 5 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        face_pull 3x12
        incline_pushup_downline 3x10
        lat_pull_down_assisted 3x12
        core_stability_antirot 3x12
      cooldown:
        thoracic_m0vement 5 minutes
    WEEK 1: Thursday rest
    WEEK 1: Friday training 40m "Grip & Scapular Strength"
      warmup:
        5 minutes rower light
      main straight_sets:
        farmer_walk 3x30 seconds
        cable_external_rotation 3x12
        low_row 3x12
        pallof_hold 3x15 seconds each side
      cooldown:
        scapular_pushups 2x12
    WEEK 1: Saturday Sunday rest
  PHASE "Phase 2: Strength Base (4 weeks)" (weeks 5-8):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Strength - Push/Pull"
        warmup:
          cardio 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_floor_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          single_arm_db_row 4x8 each side rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          incline_db press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          seated_band_row 3x12
        cooldown:
          doorway_stretch 2x30 seconds
    WEEK 5: Tuesday rest
    WEEK 5: Wednesday training 45m "Stability & Mobility"
      warmup:
        mobility 6 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        prune_serratus_push 3x12
        banded_external_rotations 3x15
        suitcase_walk 3x30 seconds
        pain_free_external_rotations 3x12
      cooldown:
        prone_swim_through 5 minutes
    WEEK 5: Thursday rest
    WEEK 5: Friday training 50m "Horizontal Pull Emphasis"
      warmup:
        rower 5 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        chest-supported_row 4x8
        cable_pull_through 3x12
        machine_hz_press 3x12
        rdl_supported 3x10
      cooldown:
        scalene_stretch 2x30 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3: Practical Strength & Conditioning (Weeks 9-12)" (weeks 9-12):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Load Progression"
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press_floor 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 4x8
          landmine press (low) 3x10
          face_pull_2 3x12
        cooldown:
          pec_minor_release 2x30 seconds
    WEEK 9: Tuesday rest
    WEEK 9: Wednesday training 50m "Posterior Chain & Scapular Stability"
      warmup:
        mobility 6 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        trap_bar_rows 4x8
       单_arm_bpull 3x12
       orkan_rc_extend 3x12
        mcglothin_fern 3x12
      cooldown:
        self_myofascial_release 5 minutes
    WEEK 9: Thursday rest
    WEEK 9: Friday training 55m "Accessory & Conditioning"
      warmup:
        light jog 5 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        cable_external_rotation 4x12
        incline_gh press (pain-free) 3x12
        rotator_cuff_circuit 3x12 each
        slow_control_pushups 3x8
      cooldown:
        mobility_flow 5 minutes

Notes:
- No overhead loading at any phase due to subacromial impingement; all pressing performed at or below shoulder height and with pain-free ROM.
- All exercises listed should be adapted to the client’s pain-free range and physio guidelines. If any movement triggers pain, substitute with a pain-free alternative (e.g., floor press instead of overhead press, incline variations, or machine-based options).
- Reps/sets are in the required WPL-AI format. RPE values are included for guidance where appropriate.
- Ensure proper warm-up and cooldown in every session; prioritize scapular mechanics, rotator cuff activation, and thoracic mobility.
- Progression: increase load by ~2.5–5% or add 1 additional rep per set when RPE remains at or below target and technique stays clean. If pain arises, reduce load or revert to the previous week’s volume.
